title: Certificate Validity and Validation Reuse Limits
content:
Under the CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, each certificate of SSL/TLS Certificates has a maximum validity, and each completed validation may be reused only for a limited number of days. This compliance schedule records those limits for every Harborline certificate product, together with the effect of a registrant change and the sharing of organisation validation across orders.

## Schedule of limits

| Certificate product | Longest validity of one issued certificate (days) | Longest validity from 15 March 2027 (days) | Domain control validation reusable for (days) | Organisation or extended validation reusable for (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 200 | 100 | 200 | 0 |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 200 | 100 | 200 | 0 |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 200 | 100 | 200 | 0 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 200 | 100 | 200 | 398 |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 200 | 100 | 200 | 398 |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 200 | 100 | 200 | 398 |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 200 | 100 | 200 | 398 |

- The 200-day validity is the limit under the Baseline Requirements in force; the 100-day figure is the limit from 15 March 2027 under the Baseline Requirements schedule.
- A completed domain control validation may be reused for issuance or reissue for the days shown. A completed organisation (or extended) validation may be reused for the days shown; the figure is 0 where no organisation validation is performed, as for the three DV products.

## Registrant change and shared organisation validation

| Certificate product | A registrant change of the covered domain voids reuse of earlier domain validation | A completed organisation validation also serves the customer's other OV and EV orders for the same organisation |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | Yes | No |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | Yes | No |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | Yes | No |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | Yes | Yes |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | Yes | Yes |

## Compliance Q&A

**Does the organisation validation reuse period apply to DV products?** No. The three DV products perform no organisation validation, and their figure is 0.

**Is the validity limit the same before and after 15 March 2027?** No. The longest validity of one issued certificate is 200 days under the requirements now in force and 100 days from 15 March 2027, for every product.

**Which products share an organisation validation across orders?** The two OV products and the two EV products; the DV products do not.
